media_field_findings.file.media_type: MIME based on actual SVG detection or raster decoding; e.g. image/svg+xml or image/png. This is not photographic content classification.
media_field_findings.file.structure: Original-byte structural inspection: pure_vector, mixed, embedded_raster or raster.

inspection_implementation.limits: Pure vector describes structure; it does not establish Illustrator native editing, recolorability or scientific accuracy.

media_field_findings.content_evidence_location: Exact actual source/media-scope judgments in data/visual-reviews; frozen files expose public_scope.scope_dimension, reason/evidence and reviewed_dimensions. These are decisions with provenance, not a general photo/illustration classifier.
prohibited_inferences: SVG does not imply pure vector; mixed and embedded_raster occur in public permitted illustrations.
public_allowed or unknown content does not establish photograph/illustration certainty.
Unsupported filter errors are not successful zero-result safety checks.

limits: This frozen run uses unchanged benchmark inputs and core3.4.1/index9; repaired runs must retain this failure evidence.
Only actual displayed or previously reviewed exact previews count as visual evidence. Returned files lacking exact review remain pending.
Top10 review does not establish all eligible variants as visually correct.
No data/source label or scientific metadata was injected for these tests; no pending or excluded scope decision was overridden.
